use default
use Math = System.Math
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE

let limit = 2_000
let is_prime = (0::limit) |> map(_ => true) |> collect_list()

is_prime[0] = false
is_prime[1] = false

for candidate in 2::limit do
    if is_prime[candidate] /\ candidate <= limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= limit do
            is_prime[multiple] = false
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

goldbach(even: int) -> int =>
    (2::even / 2)
        |> filter(p => is_prime[p] /\ is_prime[even - p])
        |> count()

let points = (2::limit / 2)
    |> map(half => (even = 2 * half, count = goldbach(2 * half)))
    |> collect()

let tallest =
    points |> reduce(0, (best, point) => Math.max(best, point.count))

let bands = [
    (residue = 0, red = 200ub, green = 40ub, blue = 40ub,
     label = "multiples of 6"),
    (residue = 2, red = 30ub, green = 90ub, blue = 190ub,
     label = "6n + 2"),
    (residue = 4, red = 20ub, green = 140ub, blue = 70ub,
     label = "6n + 4")
]

let image = IMAGE(760, 480)

image.view(
    0.0, 0.0,
    cast double(limit), cast double(tallest) + 2.0,
    52.0)

image.colour(80ub, 80ub, 80ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.x_title = "E"
axes.y_title = "G(E)"
axes.draw()

image.stroke(2.4)

for point in points do
    for band in bands do
        if point.even % 6 == band.residue then
            image.colour(band.red, band.green, band.blue)

            let x = cast double(point.even)
            let y = cast double(point.count)

            image.line(x, y, x, y)
        fi
    od
od

let step = cast double(tallest) / 15.0

for entry in bands |> index() do
    let band = entry.value
    let y = cast double(tallest) - step * cast double(entry.index + 1)

    image.colour(band.red, band.green, band.blue)
    image.stroke(2.4)
    image.line(140.0, y, 210.0, y)

    image.colour(60ub, 60ub, 60ub)
    image.text(230.0, y - step / 3.0, 13.0, band.label, Anchor.LEFT)
od

image.write("comet.png")

image.show("comet.png")
